description: Settle a swap this server made, by its refund note's handle (or its new note's): reads how it ended and does what is needed. When the swapped note's money waits at the swap's escrow, it brings it back as the refund note through the relay; when the refund note can't take it (the vault's fee rose, or the vault is full on routers with an exit), it sends it to a `to` address you give, which is public and goes through the owner's limits like any spend.

note.description: The swap's refund note handle (gloam_list_notes shows it), or its new note's.

to.description: Only for an exit: the 0x address the waiting money goes to. Public.

name: gloam_finish_swap
title: Finish a private swap
